name: High School English Writing Coach(高中英语写作全能教练)
desc:
Powered by Vue 3, Dify, & LeanCloud. Delivers a full loop: Error Detection → Issue Clustering → Targeted Resource Generation.
基于 Vue 3 + Dify + LeanCloud 的写作私教。实现“错误检测 → 问题聚类 → 资源生成”的全流程闭环。

name: SBTI 精神状态测试
desc:
Built with Vite, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. An entertainment-oriented personality test web app  featuring a 36-question quiz, state matching, personality atlas, and shareable result cards. Reached about 50,000 users.
基于 Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 开发的娱乐型人格测试网站，包含 36 题测评、状态匹配、人格图鉴与结果分享卡片，累计约 5 万用户。
